config.label: + programmatic verifier with one revision round-trip

ticket.summary: Intake was an active spray from the braided supply line at the kitchen faucet connection (S1 at first contact); customer closed both fixture shutoffs per PB-01 and leak is now contained to a slow drip, so downgraded to S2 with kitchen sink out of service - booked first priority slot 9/1 08:00.
mitigation_advice: Closed the hot and cold fixture shutoff valves on the supply lines under the kitchen sink, turning clockwise until snug - spray stopped, minor drip remains [PB-01]
Advised to leave the fixture valves closed and not use the kitchen faucet until the technician arrives [PB-01]
Standing instruction: if the spray resumes or water becomes uncontrollable overnight, text back immediately and on-call will be paged (reverts to S1) [PB-01]
ticket.customer_message: You're all set, Dana - booked for tomorrow, Tuesday Sept 1 at 8:00 AM at 48 Union Ave, Apt 2. Leave that shutoff valve closed and avoid using the kitchen faucet until we arrive; if the leak starts spraying again overnight, text back and I'll page the on-call plumber right away.

safety_overrides: [verifier] stripped 1 repair line(s) from S1 ticket
[verifier] removed calendar slot from S1 ticket (on-call dispatch)
verifier_issues_initial: S1 ticket must not contain repair quote lines (only EMERG-CALLOUT)
S1 ticket must not book a calendar slot (on-call dispatch)

ticket.summary: Sewage backing up through bathtub drain with toilet gurgling when kitchen sink runs - likely main line blockage at 9 Delmore St; on-call plumber paged.
mitigation_advice: Stop using ALL water in the home - no flushing, sinks, laundry or dishwasher [PB-05]
Keep people and pets away from the affected area and do not touch standing sewage [PB-05]
ticket.customer_message: Got it - 9 Delmore St, and I'll have them reach you at +1-555-0102. Our on-call plumber has been paged and should call you back within about 15 minutes with a firm ETA - typically on site within the hour or so for a sewage backup. There's a $150 after-hours emergency dispatch fee; the repair itself gets quoted once he's assessed the main line. Keep the water off until he arrives.

ticket.summary: Customer reports rotten-egg/sulfur smell near water heater at 220 Percheron Rd (plus week-old slow basement floor drain and musty odor); household evacuated, gas utility/911 advised, on-call paged.
mitigation_advice: Evacuate everyone and the dog from the house immediately [PB-06]
Do not operate light switches, phones, or appliances inside [PB-06]
Call the gas utility emergency line or 911 from outside and wait for the all-clear before re-entering [PB-06]
ticket.customer_message: Good — stay outside and don't go back in for anything. Call the gas utility's emergency line (or 911) now from outdoors and let them clear the house before anyone re-enters [PB-06]. Our on-call plumber has been paged and is en route to 220 Percheron Rd; he'll assess the water heater and the slow drain once the gas company says it's safe. Text me here if anything changes.

ticket.summary: Active water leak pouring through dining room ceiling light fixture, likely from upstairs bathroom; customer closed house main near water heater in garage and bled pressure — on-call dispatched tonight.
mitigation_advice: Shut off the house main (wheel clockwise); located it by the water heater in the garage [PB-02]
Stay clear of the sagging water-heavy ceiling and do not touch the light fixture or switch [PB-08]
Try the fixture shutoff under the upstairs toilet/sink if safely reachable [PB-01]
Open the lowest cold tap (basement sink) to drain remaining line pressure [PB-03]
ticket.customer_message: You're all set, Maria — 31 Halcyon Ct is dispatched to our on-call plumber, and he'll call your number on the way. Keep the main off and the basement tap open until he arrives, stay out from under that ceiling and leave the dining room light switch alone. Towels and the bucket are a good call — hang tight, help is on the way.

ticket.summary: Repeat customer's gas water heater pilot won't stay lit (started tonight, dies ~10 min after lighting) - no hot water, infant in home; no gas smell, no leak. Booked first priority slot for thermocouple service.

quote_lines.description: Water heater pilot/thermocouple service - flat rate; unit installed by us last year, check parts warranty on site

ticket.customer_message: You're all set, Sam - booked for Tuesday, Sep 1 at 8:00 AM at 77 Birchwood Ln, first stop of the day. Tonight you can leave the heater as is; there's no leak or gas odor, so nothing needs shutting off. For the baby's bottles, warming water on the stove is your best bet until we're there. See you in the morning!

ticket.summary: Leaking braided supply hose under bathroom sink; customer closed fixture shutoff and leak stopped, but the unit's only full bathroom is out of service - needs supply line replacement.
mitigation_advice: Confirmed customer closed the fixture shutoff valve under the sink (clockwise until snug) - leak fully stopped [PB-01]
Advised leaving the fixture shutoff closed overnight until the tech arrives [PB-01]

quote_lines.description: Supply line replacement - braided hose under bathroom sink

ticket.customer_message: You're all set, Jess - I've reserved the 8:00 AM priority slot for tomorrow (Tue Sep 1) at 12 Foundry Row, Unit B. Leave that sink valve closed overnight. The tech will replace the braided supply line at the flat rate of $129 and will flag anything extra before doing it. See you at 8!

ticket.summary: Only toilet in home fully blocked, bowl near overflow after flush, plunger failed; other drains draining normally so likely local clog - first priority slot booked.
mitigation_advice: Do not flush again and do not re-plunge while the bowl is full (overflow risk).
Optional: close the toilet's own supply shutoff valve - small oval/football handle on the supply line behind the toilet, clockwise until snug, to prevent an accidental flush overflowing [PB-01].
ticket.customer_message: You're all set, Aiden - a Brookdale plumber will be at 5 Coppersmith Ave tomorrow (Mon Sep 1) at 8:00 AM, about 45 minutes on site, flat $149 to auger the toilet clear. Tonight: no flushing, no plunger; optionally close the toilet's supply shutoff valve behind the toilet [PB-01]. If water starts backing up into the tub/shower or the bowl overflows, text back and we'll page the on-call plumber.

ticket.summary: Upstairs toilet running continuously for a few days; contained, no overflow; 12-year-old fixture — book standard fill/flush valve rebuild.
mitigation_advice: Close the toilet's own shutoff valve (oval handle on supply line, clockwise until snug) to stop water waste between flushes, reopening when needed [PB-01]

quote_lines.description: Running toilet rebuild (fill+flush valve), parts and labor

ticket.customer_message: All set, Nora — you're booked for Tuesday, Sept 1 at 10:30 AM at 402 Ashgrove Ter. The $189 flat rate covers labor and the standard fill/flush valve parts; if the tech finds something extra (e.g. a bad supply shutoff valve, $139) he'll quote it before doing the work. Closing the valve behind the tank will stop the trickle until then [PB-01].

ticket.summary: Kitchen sink (both basins) draining slowly for ~2 weeks, gradually worsening; no backup, odor, or other affected drains; baking soda/vinegar failed.

quote_lines.description: Kitchen/bath drain snaking - clear clog in shared kitchen sink drain line

ticket.customer_message: You're all set, Tom - see you tomorrow afternoon. Booked: Tue Sep 1, 3:00 PM at 88 Larkspur St. - kitchen drain snaking, $179 flat rate, about 1 hour. Nothing you need to do beforehand; just leave the cabinet under the sink clear if you can. Reply here if anything changes or the sink stops draining entirely.

ticket.summary: Steady drip from spout of original 1990s bathroom faucet, no leaks under sink; cartridge replacement booked.
mitigation_advice: Close the small oval shutoff valve on the supply line under the sink, clockwise until snug, to stop the drip overnight [PB-01]

quote_lines.description: Faucet/shower cartridge replacement - old (1990s) bathroom faucet

ticket.customer_message: You're all set, Grace - see you tomorrow! Booked: Mon Sep 1, 10:30 AM at 16 Weaver Court, faucet cartridge replacement, $159 flat rate (~70 min). If the drip turns out to be something other than the cartridge, the tech will walk you through options before doing any extra work. And yes - shutting that under-sink valve tonight should buy you some sleep.

ticket.summary: Dinner-plate-sized damp yellow stain on bedroom ceiling, 3 days old, not dripping or growing, directly below upstairs neighbour's bathroom (neighbour reports no visible leak) - needs source diagnosis.
mitigation_advice: No emergency action needed tonight; monitor the patch and stay clear of the area if the drywall begins to sag or bulge [PB-08]
Call back immediately for on-call dispatch if it starts dripping, spreading, or sagging [PB-08]

quote_lines.description: Diagnostic visit / camera inspection to locate ceiling leak source

ticket.customer_message: You're booked: Tuesday Sep 1, 10:30am at 230 Quarry Rd, Apt 5C - diagnostic visit, $89, about 45 minutes. If the patch starts dripping, spreading, or the ceiling begins to sag before then, stay out from under it and call us right away and we'll page the on-call plumber [PB-08]. It'd also help if your neighbour can avoid using that bathroom's shower/tub the morning of the visit so we can test it fresh.

ticket.summary: Kitchen garbage disposal hummed without spinning due to a peach pit jam; customer cleared it herself with playbook guidance, no visit needed.
mitigation_advice: Never reach into the disposal, even when switched off [PB-07]
Unplug the unit or switch off its breaker before working on it [PB-07]
Use a flashlight and tongs/pliers to remove the visible object (peach pit) [PB-07]
Use the hex/Allen socket under the unit to rock the flywheel free [PB-07]
ticket.customer_message: Got it — 3 Sandpiper Way, noted. Glad it was a cheap fix! Going forward, keep pits, bones and fibrous stuff (celery, corn husks) out, and run cold water while it grinds. If it ever hums again and the Allen key won't budge it, text us and we'll get a tech out. Have a good night!

ticket.summary: Repeat low water pressure at master shower only (recurring from March service); no other fixtures affected, no leak/gas/sewage - diagnose to root cause and replace worn cartridge rather than clean/adjust.

quote_lines.description: Diagnostic visit to trace pressure restriction (head/screen, cartridge, or mixing valve)

ticket.customer_message: You're booked, Priya - Tuesday Sep 1 at 3:00 PM, 140 Elm Hollow. I've flagged the ticket as a repeat of the March call with a note to the tech: diagnose to root cause and replace the worn part, no clean-and-adjust patch. Quote is $89 diagnostic + $159 shower cartridge replacement ($248), about 2 hours on site. If the diagnostic points to something bigger (like the mixing valve body), the tech will walk you through options and pricing before doing any work.

ticket.summary: Homeowner requesting quote for proactive replacement of 14-year-old 40-gal gas water heater in garage at 61 Foxtail Dr.; wants written quote and permit fee from office, no scheduling yet.
mitigation_advice: If the tank begins leaking or overheating: turn the gas control dial to OFF, close the cold-water inlet valve on top of the tank, and do not drain it yourself [PB-04]

quote_lines.description: 40-gal gas water heater replacement (like-for-like swap; includes tank, old unit removal/disposal, standard supply lines, gas connector and shutoff). Excludes venting upgrades, expansion tank, pan/drain if required by code, and municipal permit fee (passed through at cost).

ticket.customer_message: Perfect — 61 Foxtail Dr., garage install, noted. I'll pass this to the office as a quote request so they can send you the written quote with the permit fee for your city and a firm price window. No appointment booked; just reach out when you're ready and we'll schedule (plan on about 4.5 hours on site). One thing to file away: if the tank ever starts leaking or overheating before then, turn the gas control dial to OFF and close the cold-water inlet valve on top of the tank — don't try to drain it yourself — then call us [PB-04].

ticket.summary: 15-year-old garbage disposal seized (hums then trips reset) at 27 Garnet St Apt 1; sink drains fine, no leaks - straight replacement booked Mon Sep 1 3:00 PM.
ticket.customer_message: You're all set, Yuki! Booked: Mon Sep 1, 3:00 PM at 27 Garnet St, Apt 1 - garbage disposal replacement, flat rate $329 (standard 1/2 HP unit included and installed), roughly 1h45m on site. Please clear out the cabinet under the sink before we arrive so the tech has room to work. If anything changes - especially a leak under the sink - just text this number. See you tomorrow!

ticket.summary: Recurring kitchen line backup at 9 Rookery Ln (3rd this year, snaked Jan & May); draining slowly with gurgling, no overflow/sewage - customer declined re-snake, approved $89 camera diagnostic first with option to add main line clearing on site.

quote_lines.description: Diagnostic visit / camera inspection of kitchen branch and main line

ticket.customer_message: Camera-only is fine. Held tomorrow, Tue Sept 1 at 3:00 PM (SL-0901-1500) at 9 Rookery Ln - that slot has extra time so if the camera shows a clog the tech can clear it same visit with your approval ($349 main line clearing), no second trip. Committed cost today is just the $89 diagnostic/camera. Nothing to do tonight; go easy on the kitchen sink. The office will review your January and May visits on the ticket in the morning.

ticket.summary: Original 1990s outdoor hose bib on side of house sprays from the handle/stem when opened; fully dry when closed, so contained and non-urgent.
mitigation_advice: Keep the spigot handle turned fully clockwise/closed (fixture shutoff) until the tech arrives; it stays dry when off [PB-01]

quote_lines.description: Outdoor hose bib replacement (original 1990s bib, worn stem/packing)

ticket.customer_message: You're all set, Faye! Booked for Tuesday, Sep 1 at 10:30 AM at 455 Meadowbrook Rd — the tech will text ahead. Keep that handle fully closed until then, and if it ever starts leaking with the handle off, text us right away. Quote: HOSE-BIB-REPLACE $169 flat rate, about 80 minutes on site.

ticket.summary: 7-year-old gas water heater rumbling/popping when heating, no leaks, no gas smell, hot water normal - never flushed, sediment buildup; booked flush service.
mitigation_advice: No shutoff needed tonight - no leak or gas smell; noise is sediment boiling, not an explosion risk.

If water ever appears at the base of the tank: turn the gas control dial to OFF (or switch off the water heater breaker), then close the cold-water inlet valve on top of the tank; do not drain the tank yourself [PB-04].
ticket.customer_message: All set, Denis - happy to talk you down! Booked: Mon Sep 1, 10:30 AM at 72 Tanager Way - water heater flush & sediment service, $139 flat, roughly 75-90 min. No need to do anything tonight; just call us right away if you ever spot water at the base of the tank.
